periods.summary: Yuri's vol-08 focus comes in Episode0. One year before vol-01 she serves as an entrance-exam examiner. After Ikki helps her when she collapses, he challenges her directly, identifying her as the strongest person present. She accepts, first testing him with Violet Pain, then engaging him as a teacher determined to stop him from walking a self-destructive path. She loses when Ikki copies and evolves her swordsmanship, withstands shared injuries, uses Ittou Shura and disarms her with an adapted empty-hand technique. Though she admits him, she begs him to reconsider the knight path; a year later she tells him to prove her fears wrong with his weakest strength.

key_events.summary: Accepts Ikki's challenge, loses the entrance duel, admits him and warns him about his self-destructive path.
